answer: Let T be a spanning tree of G. Since T has at least two vertices, it has two distinct leaves x and y (for example, the endpoints of a longest path in T are leaves). Deleting a leaf from a tree leaves a connected tree on the remaining vertices. Thus T-x and T-y are connected. Since T-x is a subgraph of G-x, and T-y is a subgraph of G-y, both G-x and G-y are connected. Hence x and y are two distinct vertices whose deletion leaves G connected. This does not require G itself to be acyclic: cycles merely supply extra edges beyond those of the spanning tree.

approaches.description: Choose a spanning tree and use two of its leaves; connectivity after deletion is witnessed by the remaining spanning-tree edges.
approaches.reason: It applies to every finite connected undirected graph, including graphs with cycles.

claims.statement: There exist two distinct vertices x,y of G such that G-x and G-y are connected.
Every finite connected undirected graph has a spanning tree.
A finite tree with at least two vertices has at least two distinct leaves; endpoints of a longest path give such leaves.

proof_steps.justification: By the standard spanning-tree fact for finite connected graphs, choose a spanning tree T of G. It has the same vertex set as G.
proof_steps.statement: Choose a spanning tree T of G.

proof_steps.justification: T has at least two vertices. A longest path in T has two distinct endpoints, and neither endpoint can have a neighbor outside that path, since that would extend the path. Thus these endpoints x and y are distinct leaves of T.
proof_steps.statement: The tree T has distinct leaves x and y.

proof_steps.justification: For a leaf x, any two vertices other than x are joined in T by their unique path, which cannot pass through x because x has degree one and is not an endpoint of that path. Hence T-x is connected. The same argument applies to y.
proof_steps.statement: Both T-x and T-y are connected.

proof_steps.justification: T-x is a spanning subgraph of G-x, so paths in T-x also occur in G-x; therefore G-x is connected. Likewise G-y is connected.
proof_steps.statement: Both G-x and G-y are connected.
